card.name: "In" after iron overdose warning
card.fires_on: The word "In" starting the sentence "In case of accidental overdose" right after the iron-product child-poisoning warning. Weaker on a few other linking words in warnings.

modes.label: Iron overdose warning
modes.description: Sentence-initial "In" after the line about keeping the product out of reach of children.
modes.example: Keep this product out of reach of children.<< In>> case of accidental overdose, call a doctor

modes.label: Other linking words
modes.description: Occasional small words in warning or contraindication text, such as "who" or "with".
modes.example: Known Hypersensitivity INCRELEX should not be used by patients<< who>> are allergic to mecasermin (rh

card.plain: It fires on the "In" that opens the standard "In case of accidental overdose, call a doctor" sentence in iron warnings.
